name: Djed Stablecoin
oneLiner: DJED is COTI's overcollateralized Cardano dollar stablecoin, minted against ADA reserves while SHEN holders absorb reserve volatility within a target band.

obituary.epitaph: The Djed bank set a closing date with ADA still in the vault
obituary.obituary: COTI launched DJED on Cardano mainnet on January 31, 2023 as a Djed reserve-bank stablecoin: holders minted and burned DJED against an ADA reserve, and the SHEN reserve coin absorbed ADA volatility inside a 400% to 800% reserve-ratio band. Supply peaked at about $6.0M in December 2023 and stood near $3.8M in January 2026 before falling through the year. Pharos's July and October 2026 reviews found the reserve ratio below the 400% minting floor, and the official dashboard showed 332% with zero mintable DJED on October 30, so holders could burn DJED but not mint it. On November 17, 2026 the Djed team announced that DJED and SHEN services will wind down at 23:59 UTC on December 31, 2026. It told holders to redeem through djed.xyz after withdrawing any liquidity-pool or lending positions, said every redemption is subject to the reserve ratio, and said remaining funds will be allocated to outstanding DJED and SHEN holders once the wind-down completes. At the November 19 archive capture about $984K of DJED was still in circulation, down from $1.42M a month earlier, and traded near $0.972, while the Djed bank contract held about 22.4M ADA (about $3.45M). Pharos freezes DJED as an archived wind-down asset; the protocol redemption window that closes on December 31 is the holder exit, not a continuing stablecoin.
